newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil portworkers call off two-day-old strike.
newsitem.headline: Brazil portworkers call off two-day-old strike.

text.p: Striking Brazilian portworkers were due to return to work later Wednesday after controversial labor rules were removed from a shipping bill approved by Brazil's lower house, a union official said.
"We are sending out faxes to our members across Brazil and they will return to work tonight," said Jose Peres Cesar, president of the National Portworkers Federation.

Peres said the decision to end the strike had been taken after lawmakers agreed to drop from the bill a clause which would have allowed members of foreign crews carry out tasks currently reserved for Brazilian port workers.
Portworkers went on strike Tuesday to demand the change. Operations at several major Brazilian ports were affected by the stoppage.
Peres said he expected operations to begin returning to normal from 1900 local/2100 GMT.
